description: This month, I joined Karen Y. Chen, Executive Director of the Chinese Progressive Association, and Maria Belén Power, Associate Executive Director of GreenRoots, to author an op-ed in Commonwealth Magazine in support of adding a representative from an environmental justice community to the new MBTA Oversight Board. Environmental justice communities rely on transit the most. …
title: Environmental Justice Communities Need Representation on the New MBTA Board | Adrian Madaro | Adrian Madaro
